dedupe_keys.name: traceable and scalable food balance sheets from faostat supply and utilisation accounts 2010 2022 built with the gcamfaostat r package

description: This dataset rebuilds food balance sheets for every country from FAO's detailed supply and utilisation accounts in a way that can be traced item by item and scaled to any level of aggregation. It was produced by Xin Zhao, Maksym Chepeliev and Neus Escobar Lanzuela with gcamfaostat, an open R package from the Joint Global Change Research Institute that prepares and harmonises FAOSTAT data for the GCAM model. The Zenodo record holds supply and utilisation accounts for 2010 to 2022, a version with food calories and macronutrients, the nested mapping from detailed commodities to balance-sheet aggregates, and metadata. The files are free to download, and the package, available under a BSD-2-Clause licence, lets users regenerate them when FAOSTAT is updated. Caveats: figures inherit FAOSTAT's gaps and estimates, the process depends on FAOSTAT releases, and users need R to rebuild or extend it. Coverage is global. Simulation uses: consistent production, trade, stocks and food-use accounts for food supply network and shock propagation models, and the agricultural input data for integrated assessment scenarios. Related records: the WFP global food prices database (data-wfp-global-food-prices) complements these quantity accounts with prices.
